check.note: INCONCLUSIVE: in this EI-at-IS situation the rule, `assiette forfaitaire` and `assiette forfaitaire max indépendant` all evaluated to null (non applicable), so no executable check settles the 10 % threshold; the bénéficiaire tree apparently needs a company/associate context that was not reproduced within the T0 budget. From the YAML only: `assiette forfaitaire max indépendant` = (entreprise . capital social + compte courant d'associé) x 10 % and `assiette régime indépendant` = bruts - min(bruts, that) — primes d'émission are not included and the block is marked [TODO] [dividendes-indep]. `dirigeant . indépendant . assiette des cotisations` = 31 183,89 €/an with or without 5 000 € of dividends, i.e. nothing from the dividend rules reaches the contribution base here.

not_observable: D613-4 (LEGIARTI000046714712) c): classified furnished tourist lettings (6° L611-1) with 87 % abatement and 6 % global rate — no rule distinguishes this activity (hébergement is folded into 'vente restauration hébergement' at 12,3 %).

D613-5 (LEGIARTI000041918205): contributions of the micro-entrepreneur's conjoint collaborateur on 58 % (L631-1) / 46 % (professions libérales) of turnover or of the forfait — no rule (conjoint-collaborateur.publicodes only covers the classic indépendant).

D613-6 (LEGIARTI000046714699): the allocation keys other than the 16,50 % complementary-pension share (maladie-maternité 8,90 %, invalidité-décès 3,10 %, vieillesse de base 41,80 %, CSG-CRDS 29,70 % for a/d; the full tables for b, c and e) — not implemented; the micro-entrepreneur's basic-pension base uses the L613-7 II abatement instead.

L613-7 (LEGIARTI000048683570) I, 'peuvent demander que leurs cotisations ne soient pas inférieures au montant minimal de cotisations de sécurité sociale' — the option for minimum contributions (and its 31 December / 3-month request deadline) is not modelled.
L613-7 II, 'Par dérogation, cet abattement est fixé au niveau de celui mentionné au deuxième alinéa du I de l'article 64 bis du code général des impôts' (furnished tourist lettings) — not modelled.
